Loan Documentation & Bank Liaison

Sakshi Yadav & Co. assists with complete loan documentation — from ITR preparation to balance sheet compilation, bank statement analysis, and project report preparation — to help you secure the loan you need.

Scope of work

  • Home Loan Documentation
  • Business Loan File Preparation

Typical timeline: 2-4 working days. Available in person at our Noida office or online across India.

Frequently asked questions

What financial documents do banks ask for in a business loan?

Typically the last two or three years’ ITRs with computation, audited or CA-certified financial statements, GST returns, bank statements for 6–12 months, a project report or CMA data, and KYC of the business and promoters.

Can a CA certify my balance sheet for a loan?

Yes. We prepare and certify financial statements and provisional figures for loan applications, with UDIN for bank verification.

Do you help with home loan income documentation?

Yes. For salaried and self-employed applicants, we prepare income computations, ITRs and supporting statements that lenders require.
